title: manifest.json of a release (A1)
description: Frozen in phase 001. Written by k2gen release at <root>/<release>/manifest.json, last, before the tree is sealed read-only and renamed into place. A release id is <tag>-<sha12>, sha12 the first 12 hex of the sha256 of the canonical JSON of {files, images} (k2gen.model.release_id), so two compiles of one document set and one image set give one id. No secret, and no checksum of one, is in a release: deploy records the checksums of the secret files it found in its own deploy record (deploy-record.schema.json).

schema.description: This format's version; a change a reader must know about raises it.

builtAt.description: When the compile ran, UTC. Not part of the id.

previous.description: The release the needs were computed against; null for the first.

setSha256.description: The document set's hash, provenance.json's setSha256: names the approved set this release compiles.

products.description: Every product in the release, sorted by id.

status.description: Its lifecycle state in this release: the state history is the sequence of deployed manifests (ADR-055 part 4).

sha256.description: k2gen.model.set_sha256 over the product's own documents (contracts/<domain>/<product>/).

files.description: Every file of the release but manifest.json itself, path relative to the release directory, to its sha256: documents/, provenance.json, compose/docker-compose.yml and compiled/.

needs.description: What deploying this release over previous requires (ARCHITECTURE-V2 4.9).

recreate.description: Compose services whose inputs changed, recreated with --no-deps. Never a capture, Redpanda, MinIO, Postgres or Lakekeeper (A1).

trinoRestart.description: A file under compiled/trino/etc/ changed, so Trino restarts and the product DAGs drain first (k2gen.model.NEEDS_BY_PREFIX).

dagShapeChange.description: A DAG gained or lost a task, so the DAGs drain first.

ddl.description: Tables the additive DDL creates or widens, <warehouse>.<namespace>.<table>: one per added or changed compiled/lake/ddl/<engine>/<warehouse>.<namespace>.<table>.sql (k2gen.model.ddl_path).

sha1.description: A git commit, 40 lower-case hex digits.

utc.description: An RFC 3339 time in UTC, Z suffix.

tag.description: A release tag: v<major>.<minor>.<patch> with an optional pre-release part, v3.0.0-alpha.3-rc.1.

relpath.description: A relative path with / separators, no empty, . or .. segment.

images.description: Compose service to the image it runs. Also the shape of the --images input of k2gen release.

imageRef.description: A registry image by digest, repo@sha256:<64 hex>, or a local build tagged <name>:<image id 12> at build and checked against docker inspect .Image.
